_meta.purpose: Candidate hard queries for golden-dataset expansion (Track 1.2). Graded via scripts/benchmark/grade_candidate_queries.py before promotion into golden_dataset.json.
_meta.design: Distractor-heavy (same-named methods across classes), cross-file siblings, and behavioral paraphrases with low lexical overlap. Queries avoid the target's distinctive tokens so BM25's lexically-nearest match is a distractor.
_meta.id_range: Q100-Q133 (Q130 dropped: gold tests/conftest.py not indexed)
_meta.round1: 2026-07-26: 34 graded; 16 rank-1 easy -> 14 rephrased harder; Q123/Q127 intendeds corrected; Q130 dropped
